['Staatliche Toto-Lotto GmbH '].company_description: Staatliche Toto-Lotto GmbH operates as a state-owned lottery company in Germany, conducting state-authorized lotteries nationwide according to common principles. It supports the implementation of betting and lottery transactions and has extended its partnership with MHP RIESEN Ludwigsburg until 2026.

['BASF Schwarzheide GmbH '].company_description: BASF Schwarzheide GmbH is a subsidiary of BASF SE, a European multinational company and the largest chemical producer in the world. It operates as a chemical production site in Schwarzheide, Germany, and supplies products to a wide variety of industries.
